extension.summary: One-step setup for the Benjie Kodi build
extension.description: Installs the Benjie skin (a modified version of Bingie by matke), the Benjie helper add-ons and their settings in one step, then switches Kodi to the skin. Runs once after it is installed.
extension.news: 1.1.0 - Installs the Benjie 2.0 skin (skin.benjie) instead of Bingie: the same skin with every change the IPTV Helper Fixes add-on used to patch in at runtime already built in. On a device that already used Bingie, its skin settings & home menu are copied over first so nothing is lost. 1.0.5 - Optional GitHub sign-in in the bundled IPTV Helper Fixes 1.7.28.
